newsitem.title: UK: Howden says at advanced stage of talks for disposal.
newsitem.headline: Howden says at advanced stage of talks for disposal.

text.p: British engineering equipment maker Howden Group Plc, whose shares climbed sharply on Monday morning on takeover speculation fuelled by a newspaper report, announced it had not received any takeover bid approaches.
In a statement, it said it was at an advanced stage of talks to dispose of what it called "a non-core business activity".

"This disposal will have a significantly beneficial impact on the group's balance sheet," Howden added, explaining that its statement on bid approaches had been made after it had become aware of an unusually high level of trading in its shares and the rise in its share price.
